title: HATCH rational-weight ownership across DWG and DXF
scope: Reconcile ODA DWG HATCH spline grammar with Autodesk DXF HATCH edge fields
Compare independent open-source HATCH data models and reader behavior
Audit local PAR-115 implementation and existing focused test ownership
Refine the existing 7N.2a reader handoff into an implementation-ready fast slice

method.kind: Normative specification review, primary project source/documentation review, and local source/test audit
method.odaAuthority: Open Design Specification v5.4.1, §20.4.75, printed page 196; local PDF was read from the user-provided doc/dwg path
method.limitations: ACadSharp and ezdxf links target mutable master documentation/source and were not pinned to release artifacts. LibreDWG documentation is release-versioned while NEWS is mutable. No runtime interoperability or peer behavior was executed; sources refine data-shape expectations but do not replace ODA wire authority or independent semantic/native qualification.

findings.localGapConfirmedBySourceAudit: DWG HATCH parsing places rational BD values only in nested control Z; canonical DRW_Spline.weightlist remains empty, while DXF HATCH writing serializes weights from weightlist.
findings.existingTestCoverage: Focused generated ASCII/Binary tests exercise DXF HATCH/MPOLYGON weights and validation, but no focused DWG-reader assertion was found for canonical weightlist plus legacy Z mirror.

implementationRefinement.modelInvariant: For rational HATCH control i, preserve XY and store the scalar wire weight both in weightlist[i] and legacy controllist[i]->z. The nested planar grammar has no geometric control Z. Keep nonrational weightlist empty and current zero-Z default.
versionControls: Generated AC1027 rational one-fit control with tangent fields to avoid 7N.3 zero-fit ambiguity
fastAcceptance: Independently authored ODA-order control vectors rather than a production-encoder-only self-roundtrip
Exact canonical weights, legacy mirrors, rational flags, knot/control order and finite-value behavior
ASCII and Binary DXF group-42 export/readback with unchanged OCS XY and no geometric Z leakage
Independent rational quadratic quarter-circle evaluation at (sqrt(0.5), sqrt(0.5))
Truncated-weight negative and following edge/object sentinel alignment
Reuse existing local-roundtrip executable and one focused fast CTest owner; no new target or persistent fixture
Keep 7N.2b DWG writer authority and 7N.3 R24 zero-fit tangent policy independent
implementationRefinement.executionProtocol: After the implementation slice, update plan status and receipt, report slice progress, and continue with the next local-ready item; external/platform gates do not block this fix.
